in_hebrew.name: Heinrik
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ruler of the home
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Heinrik הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the German elements hein, meaning ‘home’ and ric, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘power’. The name Heinrik was popular among Germanic peoples, particularly during the Middle Ages.
